about: RUBBLE, account D, 12.11.2026 03:29: how the cable kit of install/tunnel/props_dressing_cables.json goes together. Units: art px, 32 a cell; world y up, picture y down. tools/cb_place.py is this file as code, and every preview was drawn by it.

character.cable: State Flex No. 3, issued by the metre and signed for in triplicate. Too thin for the lamp it feeds, so a second, thinner copper wire was wound round it "temporarily" at the first inspection. Cut once and spliced by laying the ends side by side under two wads of sticking plaster; every repair got a clerk's paper tag on a string (the tag is stamped, the splice is not insulated). Always a metre too long: the spare is looped and taped, because nobody is authorised to shorten state property. Idle: it hangs dead straight under the lamp's weight and follows it as one sheared line.
character.mount: A ceiling plate drilled for four bolts and fixed with two; the third hole weeps rust, the fourth holds a bent nail. The hook is an S of rebar; the feed wire comes through its own hole, stapled once, with a slack arc. Idle: still; the hook is the swing's pivot.
character.lamp_mount_short: A G-clamp from the motor pool, never returned: it bites girder and bracket together through a folded card wedge; the bar's other end is lashed to a rivet with wire. Idle: still.
character.loudspeaker: The censor's cable: one kink, a strain relief of plaster, and a blob of red sealing wax so nobody plugs in another voice. Under a girder: the same office's plate cut down, one bolt, one nail, a ring.
character.cut: The frayed end: the rubber peeled back, copper strands splayed like a dead flower, the wound wire sprung loose; it spits a spark now and then because nobody threw the breaker.
character.lamp: The tunnel's one honest worker (the fracture builder's line). Off, it sulks: the glass goes the grey-green of cold tea, the filament a dead grey hair. Shot, it is an empty birdcage with its floor hanging open.
character.content: No words and no letters anywhere (the tags carry a stamp blot and ruled lines), no star, no religious sign.

palette.steppedLine: a cable can also be drawn as a stepped line 3 px wide: per row, left to right, flex.lit, flex.body, flex.shadow (the light comes from the upper left); every 4th to 6th row the body pixel takes flex.shadow or the lit pixel takes flex.body (the twist); the outline colour only where a 4th pixel is wanted on the shadow side. From the hook (13 px under the ceiling line) to the lamp's anchor, x = mountX + round(topDx * t).
palette.sources: outline = the level kit's (kit_palette.json); copper_rust = its rebar ramp; plaster, paper = the level's gravel and sand ramps (palette_level2.json); steel = the lamp's own bracket; spark = the kit's fire ramp

anchorRule: A lamp or loudspeaker stands at (x, y) = its top; its mount point is (x, y + cord): the underside of the matter it hangs from. Every piece's anchor x is the CENTRE of its axis column (anchorPx x = k + 0.5), exactly as lamp_intact.png (15.5): place the cable with the same rounding as the lamp and its axis column is the lamp's column 15.

0.lamp: lamp_mount_short, its anchor on the lamp's anchor, drawn over the tiles and over the lamp. No cable.
0.loudspeaker: horn_mount_short, its anchor on the horn's anchor, drawn over the tiles; the horn's own clamp starts on the anchor line under it.

cord.1: cable_one, its anchor on the mount point (lamp: its knot rows lie over the lamp's bracket)
cord.n: top cell: cable_mount, its anchor on the mount point (x, y + n). Cells 1 .. n - 2 (from the top): one cable_seg tile each, top centre at (x, y + n - i). Bottom cell: cable_join (lamp) or cable_join_horn (loudspeaker), its anchor on the lamp's / horn's own anchor (x, y).

tiling.rule: cell i (1 .. n - 2) takes cycle[(start + i - 1) mod 10]. No tile follows itself and each comes back only after 5 cells; the tag (b) and the splice (c) come once in 10 cells, so a cord of up to 11 cells never shows either twice. Every tile begins and ends on the plain flex (columns 7-9) with the wound wire behind it, so any tile joins any tile.
tiling.start: per cable, set by hand for the level (`level` below) so no two cables that can share a screen are alike; for a lamp the level adds later: ((Math.imul(Math.floor(x), 2654435761) >>> 8) % 10)
tiling.noFlip: never mirror or flip a tile: the lit edge is on the left, and a tag hangs down

drawOrder: shadow files (_sh) of the mount or clamp, under everything of the cable
the lamp or loudspeaker (z -3), its own shadow under it
cable_join (z -2): it wraps the lamp's bracket
cable_mount / cable_one / lamp_mount_short / horn_mount_short (z 1): they lie on the matter's face

swing.about: NO filtered rotation anywhere: the lamp is one of its drawn tilts, the cable is the straight kit sheared by whole pixels. props.lamp `hangs` (the renderer's sway by rotation) must not act on a lamp that has this kit.
swing.pendulum: L = cord * 32 + 44 (px from the mount point to the middle of the glass); theta = asin(dxBulb / L)
swing.lampTop: the lamp's anchor moves to (mountX + topDx, lampY - topDy): topDx = round(cord * 32 * sin(theta)), topDy = round(cord * 32 * (1 - cos(theta))) (0 or 1 px on the level's cords)
swing.lampFrame: the frame of lamp_swing_<state> whose tilt is nearest theta (tilts [-12, -6, 0, 6, 12]). cord 0 and |theta| > 15: the nearest frame of lamp_swing_wide_<state> (tilts [-30, -24, -18, 18, 24, 30]). All frames share one anchor; the tilt turns about the chain's top link, 3 px under the anchor.

shear.rule: cable row r (0 = the first row under the ceiling line, r < cord * 32) is drawn moved by off(r) whole px: off = 0 for r < pivot; off = topDx for r >= cord * 32 - rigid; else off = round(topDx * (r - pivot) / (cord * 32 - rigid - pivot)). Rows above the line (the plate) never move; cable_join's rows under the lamp's anchor line move with the lamp (topDx).
shear.why: pivot = the hook's lower curl, where the flex turns; rigid = the spare loop and the knot, which travel with the lamp as one piece
shear.rise: when topDy > 0 drop that many rows from the plain stretch (between r = pivot + 20 and cord * 32 - rigid - 4), spread evenly; or ignore a rise of 1 px

swing.theLevelsSwingingLamp: the tank gate's lamp (148.5, 13) has cord 0, swing 0.7 cells, period 150 ticks: there is no cable to shear, its whole swing is in its own chain: theta reaches 30 degrees: lamp_swing_wide_lit.

cut.on: lamp:out cause cut (cutLamps: the trench ambush)
cut.pool: frame 0: the two inner steps; after it none
cut.note: [piece, frame, ticks]; 15 ticks of the 40 the power is out

on.note: it stutters back: ember, afterglow, lit, dim, afterglow, lit

swing.x(t): ampPx * exp(-t / decayTicks) * sin(2 * pi * t / periodTicks), px of the bulb, t in ticks from the hit
swing.stop: when the envelope falls under 1 px: lamp_swing_broken frame 2 (its rest)

shot.note: the shot frames are drawn on the swinging lamp top too (same anchor rule); no pool from frame 1 on

mount.do: the matter the mount was on is gone: draw nothing of this cable any more (it fell with its plate). Today the game breaks the lamp where it hangs: play the fixture's own break there.

cableCut.when: a fixture on a cord is destroyed and leaves its cable (a loudspeaker blown off), or the new engine cuts a cord
cableCut.do: keep the cells above the cut; cable_cut with its top on that cell boundary; cable_spark centred on the cut piece's tip (px [7, 13] of cable_cut) every 70 to 110 ticks for about 8 s, frame ticks [2, 2, 3, 4]

timelines.loudspeakerDangling: face `dangling` (shot under half): the cable stays whole; the horn's own art leans on its clamp. Under a girder (cord 0) the horn hangs from horn_mount_short's ring.

lamp.note: the game puts the light 1 cell (32 px) under the anchor (lampLightPos); the glass is 44 px under it and the old glow's offset is 39: a pool drawn at the game's point sits 12 px above the glass.

level.note: pieces from the top down; a loudspeaker's own art (pa_horn) is another builder's

forTheLevel: The lamp at (157.5, 18, cord 6), the goal missile's, stands in column 157, which is rock from y 8 to 23 (tunnel.json rows): lamp and cable hang INSIDE the rock. Column 156 is air.
The only swinging lamp (148.5, 13) has cord 0: on a cord it would swing as a sheared cable (previews/swing_cord7_sheared_*).
level_art.json props.lamp has `hangs: true`: the renderer sways it by a filtered rotation of up to 3.4 degrees.
newPlayfield: install/tunnel2/props/cable/ (the same kit as parts and joints, for the engine to swing and cut) and install/tunnel2/props/lamp_states/.
